_comment: Team-shared Claude Code settings for mediaworks. Personal overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). Adapted from SF 2026 templates.

permissions._ask_note: Intentionally no 'ask' rules — they create friction in bypassPermissions mode without adding safety beyond what 'deny' already provides. Team members who want extra confirmations in default mode can add their own 'ask' rules to .claude/settings.local.json.

_subagents_note: Subagent isolation via git worktrees is already standard in this repo (see .claude/worktrees/). Spawn long-running explorations + prototypes there.
_model_note: Inherit model from user-level setting. SF 2026 recommends Sonnet executor + Opus advisor (architect-advisor agent). Override per task with --model when needed.
